description: Given a local assignment g_F on each finite subset F of an arbitrary index set, with finitely many available values at each index, there is a global assignment f such that for each finite J some finite F containing J satisfies f restricted to J = g_F restricted to J.
signature:
Finset.rado_selection_subtype.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_2} [∀ (a : α), Finite (β a)]
  (g : (s : Finset α) → (a : ↥s) → β ↑a) :
  ∃ χ, ∀ (s : Finset α), ∃ t, ∃ (hst : s ⊆ t), ∀ (x : ↥s), χ ↑x = g t (Set.inclusion hst x)
